event.title: Putin's Visit to Disputed Kuril Islands Provokes Strong Reaction from Tokyo
event.canonical_title: Putin's Visit to Disputed Kuril Islands Provokes Strong Reaction from Tokyo
event.summary: Vladimir Putin visited the Kuril Islands, which are claimed by Japan, prompting an angry response from Tokyo. The islands, seized by Russia during World War II, are strategically important and rich in resources. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has publicly criticized Putin, particularly in light of Japan's sanctions against Russia due to the Ukraine conflict.

timeline.title: Russia Calls in Japanese Ambassador Amid Kuril Islands Tensions
timeline.summary: Russia has summoned the Japanese ambassador in response to Japan's condemnation of President Vladimir Putin's recent visit to the Kuril Islands, which Japan also claims. The move follows comments from Japan's Prime Minister, which Russia deemed 'anti-Russian.'
key_facts: The action was in response to Japan's condemnation of Putin's visit to the Kuril Islands.
Japan claims the Kuril Islands, which are currently administered by Russia.
